description:
Checks job start and end dates for repeated short stays and unexplained gaps between jobs, with the same rules a full HireGPS analysis uses. It reads dates only. Returns the risks found, each with its page on hiregps.app.
Example input: {"roles": [{"start": "2020-06", "end": "2021-02"}, {"start": "2022-01"}]}

end.description: End date, YYYY-MM or YYYY. Leave empty for a current job.
end.title: End

roles.description: Jobs, each with a start and end date in YYYY-MM or YYYY form.
roles.title: Roles

name: check_employment_timeline
title: Check employment dates
